message: GPIO 36 has a hardware errata: interrupts may fire spuriously during WiFi/BT light sleep. Use a different pin for interrupt-driven input.
hint: GPIO 34, 35 do not have this errata.

message: GPIO 36: Hardware errata: interrupts on GPIO 36 may fire spuriously during WiFi/BT light sleep.
`wifi.connect` can fail, and nothing here says what happens then: the program carries on without a connection.
hint: Add a fallback: `or retry(5)` to try again, `or skip` to carry on, or `or restart` to reboot.
